workflow_runs.name: Payload Protection
workflow_runs.display_title: docs: qualify story 1.10 references and explain finding the run id

head_commit.message:
docs: qualify story 1.10 references and explain finding the run id

The DW-205 and DW-206 resolutions named the story 1.10 spec without its
repository, so the reference pointed nowhere from inside EventStore. Name
the Hexalith.Platform repository path.

README and CONTRIBUTING now say where the run id that `down --run-id`
needs comes from, because `debug` does not print it and `down --manifest`
refuses with HXR024 once an earlier run used the same manifest.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
